description:
Spangdahlem AB is conducting market research for the below requirement. Be advised, this is NOT a solicitation, nor does it guarantee a solicitation for this requirement to be posted in the future. 

BRAND NAME OR EQUAL

Spangdahlem Air Base has a requirement for the following items:

A system including peripherals to assess and train visual and cognitive performance.

BRAND NAME ITEMS REQUIRED OR EQUAL:
1x Senaptec Sensory Station
1x Synchrony Pro
1x 3-year extended warranty
10x AT-Home Senaprec App Licenses for use on personal Apple or Android Tablets

Optionally:
1x Strobe Pro Eyewear

Please reach out to us to indicate your interest in providing a system with equal or comparable capabilities. Please include a description of the items included (and/or optionally available, as seen above) and a description of capabilities.
